We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.Meet your teamSAP Global Security & Cloud Compliance’s mission is to manage security and compliance risks for SAP byreinforcing a security- and compliance-first culture and by aligning people, processes, and technology to protectcustomer business operations, the company, and its employees.Within this mission, the Human Security Risk & Compliance function is evolving from a training-centric modeltoward a human-centric risk & compliance model that systematically identifies, mitigates, monitors, and reportson human-centric security risks across SAP.This role sits at the intersection of software security, secure development enablement, and Human RiskManagement, helping SAP embed security into engineering roles at scale through practical, measurable, andbusiness-relevant approaches.What you’ll doAs a Community Manager in this role, you will deliver on the following key responsibilities:Take ownership of SAP's internal security community, its members, cadence, formats, and channels, ensuring it remains active, welcoming, and valuable to security professionals, engineers, and interested colleagues alikeAnalyze the current state of the community and establish a clear, measurable baseline of community health (active participation, contribution, engagement, retention) as the foundation for members- Design and run community activities that foster engagement and knowledge exchange (e.g., meetups, brown-bag sessions, community events, knowledge-sharing formats, champion/ambassador initiatives), in close coordination with technical subject matter experts- Deliver bounded, additive improvements that raise participation and value, while preserving continuity and the community's established character- Maintain clear documentation of the community's operating model, relationships, and ongoing initiatives to ensure continuity and a smooth handover at the end of the assignment- In this role, you will be expected to:- Grow measurable, sustained engagement within the security community and strengthen its role as a channel for security culture and security-first behavior- Translate an analytical view of community health into practical initiatives with visible results- Collaborate with security subject matter experts, enablement colleagues, and engineering stakeholders to keep community activities technically credible and relevant- Operate as a dependable steward of the community, building trust with members and ensuring continuity throughout the assignmentWhat you bringBachelor's / Master's degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Communications, Business, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Business Informatics), or equivalent practical experience- Proven experience in community management, engagement, or comparable roles building and sustaining active professional or technical communities- Sufficient security literacy to engage credibly with security professionals and engineers, able to follow technical discussion, understand the domain, and earn the trust of a technically demanding audience (a security background is a plus, but this is not a hands-on engineering role)- Strong facilitation, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to connect people and motivate voluntary participation- Experience planning and objectively and turn findings into practical, prioritized action- Ability to work effectively with developers, architects, security professionals, and cross-functional stakeholders- High level of motivation, ownership, and reliability, together with fluent English language skills. German is a plus.​Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Lead Copywriter; CopywriterStellenbeschreibung:At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.Lead Copywriter, Global Creative Studio (m/f/x)Brand Marketing · Berlin or WarsawAt HelloFresh Group, our mission is to change the way people eat forever. Since our 2011 founding in Berlin, we've become the global market leader in the meal kit sector, inspiring millions of home cooks and food lovers every week. Our portfolio spans eight brands across 16 markets, from HelloFresh and Factor to Good Chop and Pets Table.ABOUT THE JOBIf you love making words work hard, this might be your job.HelloFresh Group is looking for a Lead Copywriter to join our Creative Studio and help drive copy quality across our demand generation engine. You'll work across the full funnel and across every channel that matters (TV, OOH, paid social, display, CRM, YouTube) with a particular focus on mid-funnel, paid social creative that stops thumbs and starts conversations.This is a hands-on writing role, creating everything from campaign headlines to push notifications, from social hooks to CRM journeys. You'll also bring the strategic thinking to help shape how eight global brands communicate across sixteen markets, and the collaborative instinct to consult with local teams, advise channel owners, and help more junior staffers write better.Crucially, you will help build, train, and socialize AI tools (particularly on Claude and Gemini) to create and maintain  a broad creative toolkit. You will use these tools to generate, iterate, and localize content, but you will be the creative brain behind all LLM work.This position is based in Berlin or Warsaw. Berlin-based employees have required attendance three days per week (Monday to Wednesday) at our Creative Studio in Moabit.WHAT YOU'LL DO- Write sharp, on-brand copy across the full funnel and all major channels (paid social, display, CRM, YouTube, TV, and OOH), with a particular emphasis on mid-funnel paid social creative.- Bring big-picture strategic thinking to campaign briefs and creative concepts, while staying just as comfortable writing a single subject line or a two-second video hook.- Consult with local market copywriting teams across sixteen markets, offering guidance, feedback, and creative direction that keeps their work on-brand and high-quality.- Use AI tools (especially Claude and Gemini) as part of your creative workflow: for ideation, iteration, and developing prompt frameworks and localization pipelines that improve quality and efficiency at scale.- Advise channel owners and marketing stakeholders on copy strategy, messaging hierarchy, and how to make creative work harder at every touchpoint.- Help shape, evolve, and maintain tone of voice and messaging guidelines across eight brands, ensuring they’re clear and practical enough to use at local and global levels.- Partner with designers, videographers, motion designers, and performance marketers to bring creative ideas to life and optimize them for conversion.- Interpret performance data to understand what's working, and use those insights to improve briefs, iterate on copy, and sharpen your craft.- Rigorously proofread copy. Zero typos, zero grammatical errors, no exceptions.- Manage content flows via Google Suite, Airtable, and Jira so copy moves efficiently from brief to stakeholders to market.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR- A full-time copywriter based in, or willing to relocate to, Berlin or Warsaw.- BS/MS from a top-tier university in Communications, Marketing, Creative Writing, or a related field.- 8+ years of copywriting or communications experience, ideally spanning both agency and in-house environments.- A proven track record of high-impact, English-language copy across major digital channels, especially paid social, display, CRM, email, and YouTube.- A strategic thinker who can see the big picture across brands and markets, but who is equally happy polishing a push notification or reworking a subject line.- An experienced AI worker, using LLMs as part of a creative process to generate, refine, and localize copy more effectively.- A natural collaborator who can consult with and advise local teams and channel owners—someone who leads through the quality of their thinking.- Comfortable working within brand and tone guidelines, and experienced enough to know when to push the boundaries.- Ability to write across multiple projects, brands, markets, and tones simultaneously.- A curiosity about audiences and the ability to interpret performance data to refine copy strategy.- Experience with localization and machine translation workflows is a plus.- Agency experience, particularly at a social media-focused or digital agency, is a plus.- Experience working for food or tech brands is a plus.- Knowledge of German, French, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Dutch is a plus.ARE YOU UP FOR THE CHALLENGE?To apply, please complete the application and send us a portfolio that shows your range: performance-driven digital copy, campaign thinking across brands or markets, and any examples of how you've worked smarter—whether that's AI-assisted workflows, localization processes, or something else entirely.We're excited to see what you bring to the team.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: WerbeagenturExpertenkenntnisse: KI-Tools, Werbetexten, Konzeption (Werbung, Marketing, PR)

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.The roleAs a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.What you’ll do- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellenceWhat you’ll bring- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy- You have a strong production mindset and continuously look for opportunities to improve workflows, quality, and efficiency- You stay current with developments in photography, visual production, and AI-supported content creation, and understand how to apply new technologies in a practical production environment- You have expert knowledge of Capture One and strong understanding of color grading and image editing. Experience with additional photography, automation, or AI-supported production tools is a plus- You can interpret and deconstruct creative briefs and translate them into practical photographic approaches, balancing creative intent, production realities, and visual quality- You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English_________________Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Bildbearbeitung, digital, Werbefotografie, Lichttechnik, Beleuchtung

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.The roleThis is a Mid-Level strategic procurement role and you'll own a portfolio of indirect categories (Facilities Management [FM], MRO and  Utilities, MRO) across HelloFresh's European production sites, designing and executing category strategies that deliver real P&L impact. You'll be a trusted partner to Operations, Engineering, and Finance leadership, shaping how HelloFresh invests in and runs its production network. The role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll do- Design and execute category strategies: spend analysis, market intelligence, supplier landscape assessments, and sourcing roadmaps- Lead complex RFx events and negotiate high-value contracts delivering TCO savings,not just unit price reductions- Build and manage preferred supplier portfolio per category: qualification, KPIs, and continuous improvement- Partner with senior stakeholders in Operations, Engineering, and Finance across multiple European markets- Translate business needs into procurement strategies proactively.- Drive governance and best-practice adoption: contract management, supplier risk, and compliance- Present category strategies and sourcing outcomes clearly to Director and VP-level audiences- Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in CapEx, MHE, etc. projects.What you’ll bring- 5+ years in indirect or operations procurement, with genuine category depth, not surface-level exposure- Multi-category experience in an operations or manufacturing environment (FM, MRO,, Utilities, etc.); the broader and deeper, the stronger the profile- Proven strategic sourcing skills: RFx design, complex negotiation, and contract structuring for technically complex purchases- Track record of influencing and building trust with senior, cross-functional stakeholders across European markets- Fluent in English; German and/or French language skills are a plus- Strong analytical mindset:spend data, cost modelling, benchmarking, and business case development- Able to travel to production sites across Europe, if required.Please submit your resume in English.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Initially we offer 2 years contract.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Are you up for the challenge?Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Einkauf, Beschaffung

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.About The Team:Are you passionate about building food safety standards and driving product quality? We are looking for someone with technical experience to drive food safety and quality compliance.Our Food Safety & Quality Assurance team is recruiting and we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Food Safety professional to join our international team. You will work within a team based across Europe to drive food safety and quality compliance with our Produce, Herbs & Fruit (PHF) suppliers, and work collaboratively with our procurement, sourcing, supply chain and distribution centre teams. The role will share best practice, create standardized ways of working, drive improvement in food safety & quality and lead on various strategic projects to ensure we delight our customers.What You Will Be Doing:You will...- Perform on-site supplier visits and audits to manage their approval and drive strategic improvements in quality to decrease complaints and increase customer satisfaction- Use your expertise and knowledge from industry and the supply base to develop best practice ways of working with your suppliers and internally- Strategically manage supplier product quality and performance. Delivering focussed error (complaint) reduction initiatives and identifying projects that will improve our quality and safety standards- Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance- Investigate and manage quality issues with suppliers to ensure customer availability and quality is not compromised with thorough root cause analysis and corrective action- Own your category area to achieve key performance indicators relating to out of specification deliveries, customer complaints, and compliance metrics- Manage and coordinate the onboarding of new suppliers and products ensuring compliance to food safety, legal and quality standardsWho You Are:- 4+ years of experience in quality and food safety management, ideally within the produce industry- Experience in auditing food manufacturers; additional food safety qualifications (e.g. HACCP, internal auditing) are highly desirable- Willingness to travel, including some international trips; 50% of time spent at suppliers, distribution centres and the base office- Excellent English communication and negotiation skills; pragmatic in solving time-sensitive issues - German skills are a big plus- Confident decision-maker who remains calm under pressure and in challenging situations- Thrives in a fast-paced environment with the ability to multitask across competing priorities- Comfortable working with cross-functional and international teams across HelloFresh markets (UK, DACH, France, Nordics, BNL)- intermediate to advanced skills in Google Suite / MS OfficeWhat you will get in return:● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes● Company pension scheme● Gym membership● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme● Dog friendly office!● Nursery support scheme● Cycle to work scheme● Group Life AssuranceLocation: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, LondonTo be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.Hybrid Working PolicyWe offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Lebensmittelsicherheitssystem HACCP, Microsoft Office, Lieferantenmanagement, Lebensmittelkontrolle, -überwachung, Lebensmitteluntersuchung

Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English;
